gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.title: Export Map Scroll
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.name: scroll name
gui.roleplayers_atlas.layerModal.name: layer name
config.roleplayers_atlas.fullscreen.tool: Use the whole window. A plainer background, but far more land at once.
config.roleplayers_atlas.keepZoom.toolti: The atlas opens at the scale you closed it at. Off, it goes back to the usual one every time.
config.roleplayers_atlas.keepOffset.tool: The atlas opens on the stretch of map you closed it on. Off, it shows you where you are every time.
config.roleplayers_atlas.emptyHandling.t: How the parts of the map nobody has walked yet are drawn.
config.roleplayers_atlas.zoneTitles.tool: Walking into the area around a named marker announces it on screen.
A faint chime as a place name appears.
config.roleplayers_atlas.zoneTitleSecond: How long a place name stays on screen before it fades.
config.roleplayers_atlas.zoneTitleCooldo: The least time between a place announcing itself and doing it again, so it doesn't flicker as you cross its edge. 0 turns it off.
config.roleplayers_atlas.deathMarkers.to: Mark the map wherever you died.
config.roleplayers_atlas.hideDeathsByDef: The deaths layer begins folded away every time you join a world.
config.roleplayers_atlas.graveStyle.tool: What the marks on the places you died are called.
config.roleplayers_atlas.guideArrowOpaci: How solid the arrows pointing at tracked marks are drawn.
config.roleplayers_atlas.clearTrackingOn: Stop tracking by itself once you reach what the arrow points at.
config.roleplayers_atlas.spawnMarker.too: Mark where you would wake up. Its icon, colour and opacity are changed from the atlas itself.
config.roleplayers_atlas.hearthFollowsBe: The hearth moves to a bed the moment you lie down in it. Off by default: plenty of servers let you sleep without moving your spawn, and there the bed would lie. Turn on for vanilla behaviour, where the hearth moves without waiting for a death.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.biomes.title: How biomes are drawn
gui.roleplayers_atlas.biomes.patchTitle: Paint the marked area (%s tiles) as
gui.roleplayers_atlas.biomes.patchHint: Left marks, Ctrl rubs out, Shift for an area, right for the whole biome, drag right to pan, Enter accepts, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.biomes.source.name: from the name — may be wrong
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.export.toolt: Write the map out to hand over
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.folder.toolt: Open the scrolls folder — drop someone else's map in here
config.roleplayers_atlas.elevationLow.to: Height above sea level, in blocks, past which land stops being drawn as a valley. Value suited to vanilla generation: 10.
config.roleplayers_atlas.elevationMid.to: Height above sea level, in blocks, from which land is drawn as middling. Value suited to vanilla generation: 20.
config.roleplayers_atlas.elevationHigh.t: Height above sea level, in blocks, from which land is drawn as high. Value suited to vanilla generation: 35.
config.roleplayers_atlas.elevationPeak.t: Height above sea level, in blocks, from which land is drawn as peaks. Value suited to vanilla generation: 50.
config.roleplayers_atlas.mapScale.toolti: Size of map pixels, independent of the GUI scale. 0 matches it; -1 and -2 halve it, rounding up or down.
config.roleplayers_atlas.maxTileChunks.t: Largest area drawn as a single tile, as a power of two. 0 is one chunk, 6 is 64x64 chunks.
config.roleplayers_atlas.maxTilePixels.t: Largest a tile is drawn, as a power of two. 0 is 16x16 pixels, 3 is 128x128.
How fast the map fills in after joining a world. Lower it if joining stutters.
config.roleplayers_atlas.fallbackFailHan: What to draw a modded biome with when the atlas has no picture for it and couldn't guess a near one from its tags. Rare — almost every biome carries tags.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.spawn.name: The Hearth
gui.roleplayers_atlas.spawn.lore: Where the road ends and sleep finds you.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.spawn.button: To the hearth — right-click to track, shift-click to restyle
gui.roleplayers_atlas.screenshot.tooLarg: The map is too large to save whole!
gui.roleplayers_atlas.screenshot.fullWar: Saving a large map can take a while — the view will briefly sweep across the whole explored area.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.screenshot.failed: Failed to save the map image!
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.exportFailed: Failed to save the map scroll!
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.imported: Map imported: %s landmarks, %s terrain regions, %s corrections
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.wrong_dimens: This scroll was made in another dimension!
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.read_failed: Failed to read the scroll file!
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.author: Authorship: %s
gui.roleplayers_atlas.screenshot.author: Authorship: %s
gui.roleplayers_atlas.marker.label: Label
gui.roleplayers_atlas.biomes.pickHint: Left marks, Ctrl rubs out, right for the whole biome, drag right to pan, Enter lists biomes, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.territoryHint: Left paints, Ctrl erases, Shift for a large area, right pans, Enter confirms, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.routeHint: Left drops a point, right takes the last one back, drag right to pan, Enter confirms, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.route.eatingOrigin: Points taken off the road as it was: %s. Take them all and confirm, and the road is gone. Esc undoes this.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.source.toolt: Take marks in from a map scroll, or from the waypoints Xaero's minimap has kept
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.setsAsLayers: Each Xaero waypoint set becomes a layer of the same name; off puts everything in your personal layer
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.pickXaero: Choose a world on the left
gui.roleplayers_atlas.markerHint: Left places the mark, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.labelHint: Left places the inscription, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.eraseHint: Left rubs a mark out, hold Shift to keep rubbing, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.territoryEditHint: Left adds a tile, Ctrl rubs out, Shift for a large area, right pans, Enter saves, Esc undoes
gui.roleplayers_atlas.territory.erasedAl: The whole zone is rubbed out. Confirm and it is gone. Esc undoes this.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.biomes.shared.tool: Biome corrections that arrived on other people's scrolls. They sit as separate sheets under their authors' names and never overrule your own — any sheet can be torn out whole. Empty until someone hands you a scroll carrying corrections.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.biomes.own.tooltip: Cells you painted by hand, gathered by the look you painted them as — what covers how much ground, and each one liftable on its own.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.city.hint: Left builds, Ctrl razes, Shift for an area, right picks a brush, drag right to pan, Enter is done, Esc leaves
gui.roleplayers_atlas.city.title: What to build with
gui.roleplayers_atlas.city.own.tooltip: Everything you drew by hand, gathered by piece — what stands where and how much of it, each kind razeable on its own. On the map your own is ringed amber, other people's violet.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.city.shared.toolti: Towns that arrived on other people's scrolls. They sit as separate sheets under their authors' names and never overrule your own building — any sheet can be torn out whole.
Write onto the scroll everything you drew by hand: biome corrections, painted cells and towns. It lands as a sheet under your name, which can be torn out whole and never overrules what the reader drew themselves.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.city.heldNone: none — click right and pick a brush
config.roleplayers_atlas.showHints.toolt: The line of controls at the foot of the map while a drawing tool is in hand. Turn off once you know the keys.
config.roleplayers_atlas.stabilizeHeldMa: The atlas in your hands stops bobbing in step with you and holds level while you walk. Off by default: the book sways like any held map.
config.roleplayers_atlas.handheldScale.t: How large the atlas held in the hands is drawn. The zoom-in and zoom-out keys change it on the fly.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.quickMark.name: Quick mark
gui.roleplayers_atlas.quickMark.failed: This world's map isn't ready yet
config.roleplayers_atlas.quickMark.toolt: Under your feet, or wherever you are looking. The second lets you mark a peak on the horizon without walking to it. The key itself is rebound in the controls screen.
How far the quick mark searches for what you are facing. A line of sight that hits nothing marks its far end.
config.roleplayers_atlas.teleport.toolti: Ctrl-clicking the map sends you there. Automatic offers it only where the server lets you run the command; turn it on by hand where a permissions plugin grants it without operator rank.
config.roleplayers_atlas.teleportCommand: Sent without its leading slash, with {x} {y} {z} filled in. Servers running Essentials usually need: minecraft:tp @s {x} {y} {z}
config.roleplayers_atlas.markerSort.tool: The same thing the tab under the magnifier changes, beside the list.
config.roleplayers_atlas.reckoning.toolt: Which calendar a mark is dated in. The server's reckoning counts cycles, unias and years from the real moment the mark was drawn, on the Moscow clock the server keeps. The world day count is what the atlas used before.
config.roleplayers_atlas.showMarkDate.to: The date a mark carries on the map: its cycle, unia and year, or its day number. Turned off, marks keep their dates - they are simply not written down.
config.roleplayers_atlas.showRealDate.to: The real date and time the mark was drawn, in ((out-of-character brackets)) after the in-world one. Under the server's reckoning it is read on the Moscow clock, so it lines up with the cycle beside it.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.sort.name: Alphabetical
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.takeIn.toolt: Write the chosen scroll into your own map. Nothing changes until this is pressed. Undone with Ctrl+Z — except the terrain: explored land merges into yours and cannot be separated out again.
gui.roleplayers_atlas.share.pickFile: Choose a scroll on the left
config.roleplayers_atlas.quickMarkIcon.t: What quick marks are drawn with. A small red cross by default.
